about: 품질검사요청조회 · 입력(E040629 · E040628) — 2026-10-04 원본: 품목 줄을 든 요청(검사방법 · 품목 · 수량), 목록 [검사요청번호 · 담당자명 · 품목 · 수량 · 연결전표 · 종결여부 · 진행상태 · 인쇄], 진행중으로 열림. 품질검사입력의 [검사요청] → [잔량적용] 으로 불러오면 그 검사가 요청의 연결전표다. 우리는 검사한 수량이 요청 수량에 닿으면 완료. 2줄 요청(4 + 2) → 검사 4(일부) → 진행중 · 잔량 2 → 검사 2 더 → 완료 · 연결전표 둘 → 검사 지우면 진행중 → 요청 삭제(검사가 이어져 있으면 막힘).

shots.name: 요청 2줄 → 목록 '외 1건' 6 진행중 → 일부 검사 → 잔량 2 → 나머지 검사 → 완료 · 연결전표 → 지움
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const it = (await (await fetch('/api/items', { headers: H })).json()).filter((x) => x.active !== false); const r = await (await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ requester: 'QA재고2', remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: it[0].id, method: 'FULL', quantity: 4 }, { itemId: it[1].id, method: 'SAMPLING', quantity: 2 }] }) })).json(); sessionStorage.setItem('qr', JSON.stringify({ id: r.id, items: [it[0].id, it[1].id], name: it[0].name })); return r.requestNo + ' ' + r.requestQty + ' ' + r.statusName })()

expect:(() => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qr')); const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.innerText.includes(x.name + ' 외 1건') && t.innerText.includes('QA재고2')); if (!tr) return false; const c = [...tr.cells].map((y) => y.innerText.trim()); return c[4] === '6' && c[6] === '진행중' && c[5] === '' })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qr')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const q1 = await (await fetch('/api/quality-inspections', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ requestId: x.id, remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: x.items[0], method: 'FULL', quantity: 4 }] }) })).json(); const r = (await (await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests', { headers: H })).json()).find((y) => y.id === x.id); x.q1 = q1.id; sessionStorage.setItem('qr', JSON.stringify(x)); return r.status === 'REQUESTED' && Number(r.remainingQty) === 2 && r.inspections.length === 1 && q1.requestNo === r.requestNo })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qr')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const q2 = await (await fetch('/api/quality-inspections', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ requestId: x.id, remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: x.items[1], method: 'SAMPLING', quantity: 2, sampleQty: 1 }] }) })).json(); const r = (await (await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests', { headers: H })).json()).find((y) => y.id === x.id); x.q2 = q2.id; sessionStorage.setItem('qr', JSON.stringify(x)); return r.status === 'INSPECTED' && r.statusName === '완료' && Number(r.remainingQty) === 0 && r.inspections.length === 2 })()

expect:(() => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qr')); const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.innerText.includes(x.name + ' 외 1건') && t.innerText.includes('QA재고2')); return !!tr && tr.cells[6].innerText.trim() === '완료' && tr.cells[5].innerText.split(',').length === 2 })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qr')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests/' + x.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); const j = await d.json(); return d.status === 400 && j.message.includes('품질검사가 있어') })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qr')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; await fetch('/api/quality-inspections/' + x.q2, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); const r = (await (await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests', { headers: H })).json()).find((y) => y.id === x.id); return r.status === 'REQUESTED' && Number(r.remainingQty) === 2 })()

expect:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qr')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; await fetch('/api/quality-inspections/' + x.q1, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); const d = await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests/' + x.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return d.status === 204 })()
